headlines.title: U.S. loses measles-elimination status, erasing decades of progress
headlines.description: Measles is no longer eliminated in the U.S., a United Nations commission determined, reversing one of the country’s greatest public health achievements this century.

headlines.title: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned to lead Nvidia
headlines.description: President Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” if Jensen Huang were reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he was ousted following allegations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. NBC News’ Garrett Haake details what tech leaders are saying about the scandal.

headlines.title: Robert Pattinson named as the newest James Bond
headlines.description: Actor Robert Pattinson has been tapped to take on the role of James Bond as Amazon MGM Studios seeks to continue the blockbuster film franchise.

headlines.title: Vance says there’s ‘no daylight’ between him and Trump on the war in Iran
headlines.description: JD Vance on Monday said he and President Donald Trump are totally aligned on the war in Iran after the vice president this month attributed Republicans’ electoral beatdown in the midterm elections to voter frustrations with the conflict.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial for the killings of her three children
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy will be tried for the second time for the killing of her three children in 2023. Clancy's first trial ended in a mistrial. NBC News’ Steven Romo and Danny Cevallos detail the next steps in this high-profile case.

headlines.title: Grammys 2027 nominees: Raye, Rosalía and women artists dominate major categories
headlines.description: RAYE, Rosalía and women artists dominate Grammy 2027 nominees list

headlines.title: Somali Uber driver left with life-threatening injuries as police investigate possible hate crime
headlines.description: An Uber driver was “fighting for his life” Monday following an attack that Minnesota police are investigating as a potential hate crime against the Somali American man, authorities said.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. James Comer announces bid for Kentucky governor
headlines.description: Rep. James Comer, R-Ky., announced Monday night that he is running for governor of Kentucky in an attempt to flip the governor’s mansion from blue to red in 2027.

headlines.title: One of the victims of the Washington, D.C., gym shooting is a gun control activist
headlines.description: One of the people wounded in last week’s Washington, D.C., shooting is an anti-gun activist from Minnesota who was walking her daughter’s dog at the time, the daughter said Monday.
